sub_locations.name: Sailor's Crossing
sub_locations.description: A pier-side cobblestone plaza with a fountain at its center and the site of a grizzly murder in [[1477 DR]].

sub_locations.name: Admiral's Way
sub_locations.description: A dockside [[salt]]-strewn street with the [[Low Lantern]] located at its eastern end.

sub_locations.name: Loklee Street
sub_locations.description: The street that owed its name to the small fishing village that eventually grew to be known as [[Baldur's Gate]]; it crossed with [[Stormshore Street]] in the north.

sub_locations.name: Trade Way
sub_locations.description: An ancient, long, well-traveled trade road along the west coast of [[Faerûn]].

sub_locations.name: Stormshore Street
sub_locations.description: A street that began in the northernmost top of the harbors, circled the [[Heapside]], passed [[Sorcerous Sundries]], hooked back west, and ended at the [[Stormshore Street Dock]] where the [[Low Lantern]] was [[anchor]]ed.

sub_locations.name: Stormshore Street
sub_locations.description: A street that began in the northernmost top of the harbors, circled the [[Heapside]], passed [[Sorcerous Sundries]], hooked back west, and ended at the [[Stormshore Street Dock]] where the [[Low Lantern]] was [[anchor]]ed.

sub_locations.name: Stormshore Street
sub_locations.description: A street that began in the northernmost top of the harbors, crossed [[Loklee Street]], circled the [[Heapside]], passed [[Sorcerous Sundries]], hooked back west, and ended at the [[Stormshore Street Dock]] where the [[Low Lantern]] was [[anchor]]ed.

sub_locations.name: Bindle Street
sub_locations.description: The street that began at the [[Old Wall (Baldur's Gate)|Old Wall]] by [[Felogyr's Fireworks]], ran south with a slight curve, passed the [[Blushing Mermaid]], crossed [[Stormshore Street]], and, eventually, ended at a dock near [[Fisher's Wharf]].

sub_locations.name: Splurging Sturgeon
sub_locations.description: Once a threadbare inn and tavern, turned into a fanciful eatery specializing in seafood, both exotic and local in [[1482 DR]].

sub_locations.name: Purple Wyrm Inn and Tavern
sub_locations.description: A very famous inn and tavern frequented by merchants, business owners, and adventurers.

sub_locations.name: Ulvur's Lane
sub_locations.description: A short lane that rang along the southern side of the [[Old Wall (Baldur's Gate)|Old Wall]] from two city blocks west of the [[Gond Gate]].

sub_locations.name: Hammaskarl's Ride
sub_locations.description: The street that began at the [[Basilisk Gate]], curved south, then moved west past [[Eastway Expeditions]], and ended on an interception with [[Loklee Street]].

sub_locations.name: Talankar's Lane
sub_locations.description: The street that began at the [[Basilisk Gate]] and ran northwest, passing the [[Blade and Stars]], the [[Elfsong Tavern]], and ended at the [[Heap Gate]].

sub_locations.name: Ascloakan's Fine Inn
sub_locations.description: An inn of note at the meeting of [[Hammaskarl's Ride]] and [[Talankar's Lane]].

sub_locations.name: Windspell Street
sub_locations.description: The street that stretched from the [[Citadel Gate]], passed [[Helm and Cloak]],  and separated the [[High House of Wonders]] from the [[Hall of Wonders]].

sub_locations.name: Belltoll Street
sub_locations.description: The street that began at [[The Wide]] by the [[Hlath (family)|Hlath Estate]], moved southwest past the [[High Hall]] and the [[Helm and Cloak]] inn, and ended soon after after crossing [[Sornbanner Street]].

sub_locations.name: Wendserpent Street
sub_locations.description: The street that began at [[Black Eel Street]], moved north through the [[Manor Gate]], crossed [[Belltoll Street]], then [[Windspell Street]], passed in front of the [[Black Dragon Gate]], curved along the city walls, passed [[Rose Portal]] shrine, and curved to [[the Wide]], where it ended.

sub_locations.name: The Run
sub_locations.description: Thr road that stretched from the [[Watch Citadel]] to the [[Black Dragon Gate]].

sub_locations.name: Canary Lane
sub_locations.description: A short shady lane with dark alleys that offered hiding spots for ne'er-do-well and an access point to the [[Baldur's Gate/Sewers|sewers]].

sub_locations.name: Market Street
sub_locations.description: The street with a butcher shop, rumored to serve monster meat in [[1477 DR]].

sub_locations.name: The Western Wet
sub_locations.description: The road that ran alongside the docks from the [[Seatower of Balduran]] to the [[Water Queen's House]].

sub_locations.name: The Eastern Wet
sub_locations.description: The street that ran alongside the docks and hugged the harbors from the drydocks on the northern edge of the [[Gray Harbor]] and ended at [[Waendel's Wharf]].

sub_locations.name: Black Eel Street
sub_locations.description: The road that began at [[Glaezel's Dock]] and moved in a straight line to the west until it ended at the city walls.

sub_locations.name: Caundorl Street
sub_locations.description: The road that began at [[Hethkantle's Jetty]] and moved in a straight line to the west until it ended at the city walls.

sub_locations.name: Wendserpent Street
sub_locations.description: The street that began at [[Black Eel Street]], moved north through the [[Manor Gate]], crossed [[Belltoll Street]], then [[Windspell Street]], passed in front of the [[Black Dragon Gate]], curved along the city walls, passed [[Rose Portal]] shrine, and curved to [[the Wide]], where it ended.

sub_locations.name: Wendserpent Street
sub_locations.description: The street that began at [[Black Eel Street]], moved north through the [[Manor Gate]], crossed [[Belltoll Street]], then [[Windspell Street]], passed in front of the [[Black Dragon Gate]], curved along the city walls, passed [[Rose Portal]] shrine, and curved to [[the Wide]], where it ended.

sub_locations.description: The street that began at [[Black Eel Street]], moved north through the [[Manor Gate]], crossed [[Belltoll Street]], then [[Windspell Street]], passed in front of the [[Black Dragon Gate]], curved along the city walls, passed [[Rose Portal]] shrine, and curved to [[the Wide]], where it ended.

sub_locations.description: The street that began at [[Black Eel Street]], moved north through the [[Manor Gate]], crossed [[Belltoll Street]], then [[Windspell Street]], passed in front of the [[Black Dragon Gate]], curved along the city walls, passed [[Rose Portal]] shrine, and curved to [[the Wide]], where it ended.

sub_locations.name: Nuthkhal's Way
sub_locations.description: The street that curved, connecting the [[Manycoins House]] with the [[Cliffgate]].

sub_locations.name: Nuthkhal's Way
sub_locations.description: The street that curved, connecting the [[Manycoins House]] with the [[Cliffgate]].

sub_locations.name: Manyspears Lane
sub_locations.description: The long lane that began at the [[Counting House]], passed the [[Baldur's Gate (gate)|Baldur's Gate]] and encircled [[The Wide]].

sub_locations.name: Manyspears Lane
sub_locations.description: The long lane that began at the [[Counting House]], passed the [[Baldur's Gate (gate)|Baldur's Gate]] and encircled [[The Wide]].

sub_locations.name: Manyspears Lane
sub_locations.description: The long lane that began at the [[Counting House]], passed the [[Baldur's Gate (gate)|Baldur's Gate]] and encircled [[The Wide]].

sub_locations.name: Three Spires
sub_locations.description: One of three major moots in [[Baldur's Gate]] – the intersection of [[Hauth Lane]], [[Wendserpent Street]], and [[Blackraven Lane]].

sub_locations.name: Hauth Lane
sub_locations.description: A short street that moved roughly north to south across the [[Three Spires]] intersection.

sub_locations.name: Blackraven Lane
sub_locations.description: A short street that moved roughly east to west across the [[Three Spires]] intersection, from the [[Sashenstar]] family estate to [[Chalsendace Street]].

sub_locations.name: Chalsendace Street
sub_locations.description: A street of wealth mansions; it stretched from the city walls to [[Stormcanter Street]] by the [[Old Wall (Baldur's Gate)|Old Wall]].

sub_locations.name: Stormcanter Street
sub_locations.description: A short street on the southern end of [[Chalsendace Street]].

sub_locations.name: Fox Bottom
sub_locations.description: One of three major moots in [[Baldur's Gate]]; it was located two city blocks south of [[Manycoins House]] along the [[Stormshore Street]] (formerly known as Long Lane) in a slummy area of run-down rooming-houses.

sub_locations.name: Lathdell
sub_locations.description: The small open plaza, or strake, in front of the [[Shrine of the Suffering]].

sub_locations.name: Hulkael Street
sub_locations.description: The street that once ran to and past the [[Manycoins House]], later, just stretched between the [[Lathdell]] plaza and [[Murl's Rest]] where the [[Sorcerous Sundries]] store was located.

sub_locations.name: Murl's Rest
sub_locations.description: The triangular plaza, or strake, in front of [[Sorcerous Sundries]].

sub_locations.name: Lionsmoot
sub_locations.description: One of three major moots in [[Baldur's Gate]], named after [[The House of the Lion]] [[festhall]] located on its eastern angle.

sub_locations.name: Misty Court
sub_locations.description: A street of note where the open-air stonemason's workshop, [[Alabaster Stonecrafts]], could be found.

sub_locations.name: Trident Lane
sub_locations.description: An area in the [[Seatower]] that housed many weapon smiths who serviced the [[Flaming Fist]]. One such shop was run by an automaton in the late 15{{th}} century [[DR]].

sub_locations.name: Saint Sollars Way
sub_locations.description: The street of note on which stood the home ot Mrs. [[Leventide]] in the late 15{{th}} century [[DR]].

sub_locations.name: Old Town Avenue
sub_locations.description: A street in the [[Lower City]] known for its expensive apartments and lodgings.

sub_locations.name: Long Lane
sub_locations.description: A short street that crossed [[Stormshore Street]] at the moot known as [[Fox Bottom]].

sub_locations.name: Nortale's Hostel
sub_locations.description: Cheap temporary lodgings, used to house refugees during the [[Absolute crisis]] of [[1492 DR]].{{approx}}

sub_locations.name: Sornbanner Street
sub_locations.description: The street that joined [[Belltoll Street]] at a moot in the west and [[Wendserpent Street]] at another moot to the east.
